name: login
title: Login Block
description: Local login form demo. Connect your own authentication service.
docs: Import the installed moru/styles.css once in your application entry. Wrap Moru components in MoruProvider from moru/provider. mode defaults to light; pass mode="dark" for dark defaults. This beta is tested with Vite + React; Next.js SSR and React Native are not verified. Shared core CSS is installed once; fonts are optional and are not downloaded by this registry. Keep moru/_licenses/Moru-LICENSE when redistributing source. Guide: https://github.com/syrus-riius/moru-ui/blob/main/docs/registry.ko.md Authentication, code verification, resend, and persistence are local demonstrations; connect your own services.
